sourceSentences: While this ability is inactive, her basic attacks on-attack generate a stack of Unleash for 6 seconds, increased to 2 stacks against champions. The stacks refresh on subsequent attacks, stack up to 8 times, and expire one by one every 0.5 seconds after the duration.
Cultivation of Spirit resets Yunara's basic attack timer. Targets do not have to be visible to be hit by the spread attacks.
Cultivation of Spirit is cast alongside Transcend One's Self. If the former was not already active, this will also grant its attack reset.
Upgraded into Arc of Ruin, which has no cost and has its remaining cooldown reduced by 80% upon both entering and exiting the state.
Upgraded into Untouchable Shadow, which has no cost and has its cooldown reset upon both entering and exiting the state.
Untouchable Shadow resets Yunara's basic attack timer. Arc of Ruin can be cast during the dash.
target range: 225 - 450 (Minimum and maximum dash distance) / 550 (Maximum extended dash distance across terrain)
Arc of Judgment cast time: 0.45 to 0.225 (bonus attack speed)
Yunara becomes ghosted and gains bonus movement speed for 1.5 seconds. The movement speed is 50% more effective while facing a nearby visible enemy champion.

3 Minute LoL : Pour les combos, ayez toujours vos huit effets passifs prêts avant d'engager votre adversaire. Attaquez, utilisez votre A et votre Z, puis utilisez votre E pour poursuivre votre adversaire si nécessaire.
3 Minute LoL : Pour votre combo all-in, utilisez Z puis E, attaquez, et activez votre ultime.

Gunfire ADC : The first combo is auto attack Q reset. It works exactly like Sivir's auto attack W. So if you press Q right after your auto attack, it's gonna cancel your auto attack, and you do 2 auto attacks.
Gunfire ADC : But if your Q is already active, if you press R, it's not gonna give you an additional reset, so it only works if your Q wasn't already active.
Gunfire ADC : my W is gonna be in the same direction, but it starts where I Flash.
Gunfire ADC : I need to predict where I'm gonna land with my Flash, and use my W like that.
Gunfire ADC : I can also use my W during my E dash like this
Gunfire ADC : when you use your W, and E, if you press R after that, your E is gonna instantly get refunded, but your W gets a 70% cooldown refund.
Gunfire ADC : There are some walls that, you know, I can pass through like this one. But sometimes you can fail it.
Gunfire ADC : if I hit an enemy champion, it gives you two stacks. And you practically need six or more stacks.
Gunfire ADC : right before it starts expiring, I can just last-hit the minion, and keep my Q stacks alive
Gunfire ADC : So for the biggest potential damage, you need to do W, auto attack, R, auto attack, dash, auto attack.

Bibou : ça va être d'utiliser son Z et son E juste avant d'ulti. Pourquoi ? Parce que le Z va avoir son délai de récupération réduit de 80 % et le E va être disponible instantanément.
Bibou : il va pouvoir vous faire passer des murs. Il va pouvoir augmenter sa range si vous choisissez bien l'angle du mur.
Bibou : il y a des murs que vous pouvez faire dans un sens comme celui-ci mais pas dans l'autre.
